what: Jet-lepton overlap conventions V0/V1/V2 on the 8 rebuild-validation files
c_note: ALL, by construction: the #32 step only ever removes leptons that already passed the production selection (muons: pT>25, |eta|<2.4, mediumId, pfRelIso04_all<0.15; electrons: pT>25, |eta|<2.5, cutBased>=3 medium, which includes isolation).
a_note: leading jet = highest-pT jet of V0 (light + b, pt>30, |eta|<2.5, tight ID, no cleaning). 'triggered' = golden JSON + own trigger fired (the September population for mumu); 'accepted' = production matched4 acceptance. Electrons are after the CMS e-mu rule.
